about_short_description.short_description: Benchify is a software development firm offering review tool for the code that can help find bugs through testing.

product.name: Benchify Fixer API
product.description: An API that automatically detects and fixes errors in AI-generated code, including syntax errors, missing imports, and runtime issues, delivering corrected code ready for execution.

product.name: Benchify Automated Code Review
product.description: A formal methods-based code review service that executes code against mathematically rigorous test scenarios to detect real bugs missed by traditional reviews, without false positives.

identifier.value: Benchify Formal Verification and Custom Solutions

product.name: Benchify Formal Verification and Custom Solutions
product.description: Custom formal methods solutions that mathematically guarantee software reliability, correctness, and security for complex engineering challenges.

identifier.value: Benchify Code Correction API for UI Code

product.name: Benchify Code Correction API for UI Code
product.description: An API that automatically fixes errors in AI-generated UI code, including missing imports, broken handlers, and syntax errors, ensuring components compile and render correctly.
